name: A Greying Mirror

rarity.note: Hedge-craft of unusual refinement; the maker's art, not the object's power.

summary: A hand-mirror that shows a caster honestly: the Greying's progress reads in the reflection as a fading at the edges — colors duller, outline softer, the degree of loss exact. Hedge-witches make them for their own students, so casters can see the price they are paying. Possession is not illegal; what people do on seeing themselves sometimes is.
origin: Hedge-craft tradition; each is ground and silvered by hand over a season
current_whereabouts: A few dozen exist, mostly in hedge-witch lineages; the Censer would pay to destroy every one.
properties: Shows only the Greying — nothing else magical registers
Works for anyone who has ever worked the Glimmer, however small
Shows nothing at all for the never-cast: plain mirror
keepers: Hedge-witches and their circles; a few physicians of the rich keep one 'for diagnosis'.
value_or_danger: Fifty crowns and up. To a caster in denial: unbearable.
adventure_hooks: A young Glimmerborn sees their own fading and bolts for the Quiet that night; players are asked to find them before the Censer's wardens do.
Someone is manufacturing greying mirrors with the fade painted on — driving casters to despair, or to sale.
